name: Season Identifier
description: Use Jellyfin native Identify on a local season to map it to a different external TV title while preserving local numbering.
overview: Identify non-standard local seasons as another TV title.

versions.changelog: Adds targeted change detection for mapped episodes and seasons. A normal Jellyfin scan now detects stale SeasonId/season-number/series links by comparing them with the physical season folder, repairs those links once, and explicitly queues mapped full refreshes for the affected episodes without causing healthy mapped items to re-fetch on every automated scan.

Makes the physical season folder authoritative when repairing mapped episodes. Episode refreshes now enumerate physical descendants instead of relying only on Jellyfin's metadata-filtered season list, replace stale cached SeasonId/season-number links before refresh, and resolve mappings from the real parent season first.

Repairs mapped episode metadata by resolving the real parent season when SeasonId is not cached, expands copied source metadata, cascades manual season refreshes to child episodes, and adds mapped TMDb series posters/backdrops plus episode stills without changing the local series hierarchy or numbering.

Fixes native Season Identify on Jellyfin 12 by replacing the brittle compiled-bundle regex and external File Transformation dependency with a self-contained in-memory web middleware. The native Identify result is captured as a persistent season mapping and child episodes are refreshed through the sequential flattener.

Adds native Jellyfin Identify support for Season items. Selecting a Series in Jellyfin's normal Identify dialog now creates the title mapping automatically and refreshes child episodes through the sequential season flattener.
Initial catalog release. Supports entire-title season mapping and sequential flattening of numbered external seasons while ignoring Season 0 / Specials.

name: Visibility Manager
description: Remove selected Jellyfin library entries from normal browsing without deleting, moving, or renaming media files.
overview: Reversibly remove unwanted or duplicate library entries from view.

versions.changelog: Adds Remove directly to Jellyfin three-dot item menus on cards, lists, and detail pages. Remove is reversible visibility suppression only: media files and Jellyfin database entries are never deleted. Expands support to normal library item types while excluding structural library-root containers.

Initial release. Adds a dedicated visibility page for Series, Seasons including virtual seasons, Movies, and Episodes. Hide and Restore use a reversible Jellyfin metadata marker and native blocked-tag filtering; media files and library database entries are never deleted.

name: Library Cleanup
description: Diagnose and safely repair common Jellyfin season and episode library inconsistencies without touching media files.
overview: Scan for phantom duplicates, stale links, numbering problems, virtual items, and other TV library inconsistencies.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Adds a season/episode cleanup dashboard that detects duplicate database paths, duplicate episode and season numbering, virtual items, missing files, incomplete numbering, and stale episode hierarchy links. Safe Repair realigns stale SeasonId, SeriesId, and season-number links to the physical folder hierarchy. Duplicate database rows are diagnostic-only in v0.1 and media files are never deleted or moved.
